_README: RORgamma LBD two-state config for the Apheris Foundry hackathon (2026-10-01).
State switch = helix 12 (H12 / AF-2). Agonist state: H12 packed against the
core (agonist lock H479-Y502-F506), LXXLL coactivator groove open.
Inverse-agonist state: H12 displaced/destabilised.
PRE-REGISTERED SUCCESS CRITERION (agreed before any prediction ran):
PRIMARY (rorgamma_invago direction): a steering arm (A1 pocket-
conditioned or A3 target-template) recovers H12-out in >= 60% of seeds
with decisive margins (>= 1 A), AND the negative control (A4 wrong-
template) does not exceed the A0 baseline recovery rate by more than
10 percentage points, AND A2 (shared-pocket) is within 10 pp of A0.
Steering = arms beat BOTH the baseline and the controls. If A0 already
recovers H12-out at >= 60%, the honest headline is 'the model defaults
to the therapeutic state' -- report that, not a steering claim.
SECONDARY: pose (ligand centroid distance) and pocket-contact recall
are reported NEXT TO state recovery, never merged with it (pose !=
state, the KinConfBench lesson).
THREATS TO VALIDITY (named up front, with mitigations):
1. Contact-set leakage -- pocket sets are derived from the same crystals
used as references/templates. Mitigation: A2/A4 controls; contact
metrics reported separately; residual circularity acknowledged.
2. Template memory -- 3KYT (2011) and 4ZJW are certainly in the
training set. Mitigation: A4 wrong-template control, A5 MSA-free,
and (best) any post-cutoff pharma-drop structures from the
organisers -- prefer those if provided.
3. Unvalidated H12 region -- the region is derived from ONE pair of
crystals. Mitigation: scorer self-consistency gate on crystals
(3KYT->H12-in, 4ZJW->H12-out, 5IXK/5NTK->H12-out, 4ZJR->H12-in
decoy) BEFORE any prediction is scored; pre-registered sensitivity
alternatives for the region (auto region incl. loop 286-290; full
Reference pair chosen EMPIRICALLY, not by ligand label (state-function
decoupling is real for this target): CA displacement profiles vs 3KYT gave
4ZJW: single clean H12 segment 479-486, max 10.6 A  -> INACTIVE reference
5IXK: H12 478-487 plus loops 310-314/392-394, max 10.1 A -> alternative
5NTK: H12 476-489 plus loops, max 24.5 A -> alternative (swung-out H12)
4ZJR: max 4.9 A, 'may be same state' warning -> DO NOT USE (decoupling:
inverse agonist 4P3 with H12 still in the agonist position)
See refs_rorgamma/ref_pair_analysis.json and displacement_profiles.png.
Both entries fold the FULL LBD construct (243 res, 265-507, from 3KYT) so
the model has the option to pack H12-in; steering has to actively displace
it. state_region_seqids is the H12 segment in canonical RORgamma numbering
(= 3KYT numbering).
order_parameter is 'none': the kinase DFG check is disabled and validate
runs the generic two-reference displacement check instead.
UniProt: P51449 (RORC, NR1F3). The LBD is identical between the RORgamma
and RORgammat isoforms, so the single accession covers both.

rorgamma_invago.name: RORgamma LBD + inverse agonist 4P1 (steer to H12-out)
why: The money direction: inverse agonism is the therapeutic state (Th17
suppression), and it is the under-represented state -- apo RORgamma and
most agonist structures sit H12-in, so co-folding models should default
there. 4ZJW's derived region is a single pure-H12 segment (479-486),
which makes the state call unusually clean for a non-kinase.

3KYT.note: ACTIVE reference. Canonical agonist conformation, agonist lock H479-Y502-F506 packed. Empirically confirmed as the displaced-against state.

4ZJW.note: INACTIVE reference. Displacement profile vs 3KYT is a single H12-localised segment 479-486 (max 10.6 A), nothing else moves. Chain A kept (carries the ligand).

5IXK.note: alternative inactive ref: H12 478-487 plus loops 310-314/392-394, max 10.1 A. Use for sensitivity, not primary (loops dilute the region).

5NTK.note: alternative inactive ref: H12 476-489, max 24.5 A (swung-out helix). Extreme case; use as sensitivity check.

4ZJR.ligand: inverse agonist with H12 still packed
4ZJR.note: STATE-FUNCTION DECOUPLING DECOY: inverse agonist 4P3 but H12 stays in the agonist position (max 4.9 A, 'same state' warning). Do NOT use as the inactive reference. The scorer must call it H12-in -- if it does, that is a pitch slide.

rorgamma_invago._sequence_note: Full LBD construct read from 3KYT chain A (243 res, 265-507). Set explicitly so the inverse-agonist entry folds the complete H12 even though the 4ZJW crystal construct truncates at 486.
rorgamma_invago._smiles_note: 4P1 from RCSB chemcomp REST (rcsb_chem_comp_descriptor). Achiral (InChIKey NWECRSKQCPBSPW-UHFFFAOYSA-N).
rorgamma_invago._state_region_note: H12 segment from the 3KYT-vs-4ZJW displacement profile (threshold 2.0 A). Starts at the agonist-lock His479. Sensitivity alternatives: [286,287,288,290] + this set (full auto region), or range(470, 508) (full H12 window).
rorgamma_invago._back_pocket_note: State-specific 4P1 contacts (4ZJW numbering = canonical): 480 sits IN H12, 396/401 on the back-pocket side, 362 adjacent to the R364/R367 sulfate pocket. Derived by make_inputs --show-pocket, pasted 2026-10-01.

rorgamma_25hc.name: RORgamma LBD + agonist 25-hydroxycholesterol (steer to H12-in)
why: The agonist direction with the challenge's own ligand (25-OHC on the
intro slide). Expected to be the EASY direction: apo RORgamma
crystallises active, so the unconditioned baseline should already sit
H12-in. This entry is the positive control that shows the pipeline
works when the model agrees with biology.

3KYT.note: ACTIVE reference and the target-state ref here. Cleaned to chain A + HC2 (peptide on chain C removed so pocket derivation cannot touch it).

4ZJW.note: INACTIVE reference (other-state ref here). See the rorgamma_invago entry for the full empirical evidence.

rorgamma_25hc._sequence_note: AUTO reads the 3KYT construct (243 res, 265-507) off ref_target_state -- the full-length LBD, same construct as the inverse-agonist entry.
rorgamma_25hc._smiles_note: 25-hydroxycholesterol (HC2), stereo SMILES from RCSB chemcomp REST. InChIKey MCKLJFJEQRYRQT-MGNSQDQZSA-N.
rorgamma_25hc._state_region_note: Same H12 segment, now in 3KYT (= target-ref) numbering.
rorgamma_25hc._back_pocket_note: State-specific HC2 contacts (3KYT numbering = canonical): includes H479 and Y502 -- the agonist lock itself -- plus 364/368 at the sulfate-pocket arginines. Derived by make_inputs --show-pocket, pasted 2026-10-01.
